notes: Buttons and menu commands use the infinitive, as Windows and macOS do in Russian (Сохранить, Экспортировать как, Закрыть).
Address the person as вы, lowercase; avoid gendered past-tense forms where a neutral wording exists.
Quotes «…»; an em dash with spaces ( — ) where English uses a colon for an explanation; key names stay in English.
Diagram is схема (feminine): «Приватная схема», «Новая схема»; app names inside sentences go in «…» to keep the nominative («Ваши схемы»).

topic.note: As Yandex Cloud and Habr write; тема is Microsoft's word and also the colour theme. Avoid forms have a leading space so that «система» doesn't trip them.

partition.note: Not Microsoft's раздел, which the UI uses for a section.

dead-letter queue.note: DLQ alone as the short label.

retry.note: Button: Повторить. Redo is Вернуть, so the two never collide.

diagram.note: Feminine. Not диаграмма (a chart in Russian UIs).; Diagrams in these cloud errors is the existing folder name.

edge.note: Feminine. In shortcuts.mouse.boundary 'edge' is the border of a boundary (край), not a connection.

stencil.note: Visio's Russian calls the collection «набор элементов»; one item is элемент. The rail is «Элементы».

live.note: The mode where messages flow; 'leave live view' is «выйти из режима реального времени».

present.note: The top-bar button is the noun «Презентация».

share link.note: Menu item: «Поделиться ссылкой…» (shorter, as Google's Russian UIs).

private.note: Agrees with схема: «Приватная схема». Never секретная or конфиденциальная; the Privacy menu is «Конфиденциальность».

this device.note: на этом устройстве, с этого устройства.
